structured.answer: The page says the best choice is an account at פסגות with the fund 'ילין לפידות מחקה S&P 500', 86,492 ₪ after ten years from 70,000 ₪. But I don't understand what that fund is, and I'll ask my son or the bank before I do anything.

findings.what: Opens with English letters (S&P 500) and words like קרן מחקה. It feels like it isn't for someone like me.

The charts with tick marks can't be read. Only the sentence under them helps.
